parameters.query:
-- Кому напомнить: Клиенты с Согласием на рекламу в CRM ($1: [{channel, sender_id}]) и поводом — сезон шин
-- ($3; пусто — не сезон) или ТО: последняя Запись Клиента началась больше 11 месяцев до дня рассылки $2
-- (повод — эта Запись: после новой Записи отсчёт заново). Клиенту за запуск — одно напоминание, каждый
-- повод — один раз: строку ставит первый запуск, повтор берёт только неотправленное через 5 минут.
-- Беседа — последняя у Клиента с телефоном в Заявке: SMS Клиенту из Messenger и Instagram идёт на него.
with consented as (
  select c->>'channel' as channel, c->>'sender_id' as sender_id from jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) c
),
clients as (
  select distinct on (v.company_id, v.channel, v.sender_id)
    v.company_id, v.channel, v.sender_id, v.id as conversation_id
  from conversations v
  join consented k on k.channel = v.channel and k.sender_id = v.sender_id
  join leads l on l.conversation_id = v.id
  where l.phone is not null or v.channel = 'whatsapp'
  order by v.company_id, v.channel, v.sender_id, v.created_at desc
),
last_visits as (
  select distinct on (v.company_id, v.channel, v.sender_id)
    v.company_id, v.channel, v.sender_id, a.id as appointment_id, a.starts_at
  from appointments a
  join leads l on l.id = a.lead_id
  join conversations v on v.id = l.conversation_id
  order by v.company_id, v.channel, v.sender_id, a.starts_at desc
),
campaigns as (
  select c.*, p.campaign
  from clients c
  left join last_visits lv using (company_id, channel, sender_id)
  cross join lateral (values
    (case when lv.starts_at < $2::date - interval '11 months' then 'service:' || lv.appointment_id end),
    (nullif($3, ''))
  ) p (campaign)
  where p.campaign is not null
),
due as (
  select distinct on (p.company_id, p.channel, p.sender_id) p.*
  from campaigns p
  where not exists (
    select 1 from marketing_messages m
    where (m.company_id, m.channel, m.sender_id, m.campaign) = (p.company_id, p.channel, p.sender_id, p.campaign)
      and (m.sent_at is not null or m.claimed_at >= now() - interval '5 minutes'))
  order by p.company_id, p.channel, p.sender_id, p.campaign
),
claimed as (
  insert into marketing_messages (company_id, channel, sender_id, campaign, conversation_id)
  select company_id, channel, sender_id, campaign, conversation_id from due
  on conflict (company_id, channel, sender_id, campaign) do update
    set claimed_at = now(), conversation_id = excluded.conversation_id
  where marketing_messages.sent_at is null and marketing_messages.claimed_at < now() - interval '5 minutes'
  returning company_id, channel, sender_id, campaign, conversation_id
)
select c.company_id, c.channel, c.sender_id, c.campaign, c.conversation_id, co.name as company,
  coalesce(v.language, co.default_language) as language
from claimed c
join conversations v on v.id = c.conversation_id
join companies co on co.id = c.company_id

-- Клиенту ушло: повод больше не напоминается. Не ушло — строка ждёт повтора следующим запуском.
update marketing_messages set sent_at = now()
where company_id = $1::uuid and channel = $2 and sender_id = $3 and campaign = $4
